research_question: Does internalcot-authored rich visible reasoning add held-out diagnostic information beyond task/output structure and passive Jacobian telemetry, or does enabling internalcot mainly change the agent's behavior and control policy?

interpretation_boundary.observability: A conditional b or b_star gain is predictive association within its arm.
interpretation_boundary.intervention: A paired arm difference estimates behavior under this active prompt, skill, and CLI intervention.
interpretation_boundary.prohibited_inference: A b_star gain does not establish information available to a passive observer and cannot by itself authorize passive retention.

prohibited_methods: reasoning-trace distillation, reconstruction, or student training
raw prompt, tool argument, tool result, submission, evidence, or verifier-internal publication
feature, family, task, threshold, stopping-rule, or pair-order tuning after labels are observed
restoration of deleted workflow or generic result abstractions
a new production reasoning, retention, observer, or MCP protocol

arms.control: Normal authenticated Codex with the common task prompt.
arms.internalcot: The same Codex invocation and task prompt, prefixed by $internalcot, with the pinned official project skill installed.

observable_tuple.x: Frozen task input, public submission schema, complete task family, and fixed task metadata.
observable_tuple.y: Final answer and submitted-artifact structure plus independent verifier diagnostics, with the predicted target masked.
observable_tuple.b: Control-arm non-final ordinary agent_message items, redacted and bounded before fixed structural and lexicon counts.
observable_tuple.b_star: Treatment-arm visible internalcot note output only, redacted and bounded before fixed structural and reasoning-lexicon counts; note text is never committed.
observable_tuple.tau_tools: Ordered passive server telemetry for math.find/math.run and joined capability attempts: public operation identity, execution/evidence outcome, diagnostics, timing, response size, and digest availability; never arguments or results.

internalcot.required_adherence: Official skill loaded successfully, at least two successful note calls, first note before the first substantive operation, and final note after the last substantive operation but before the final agent message.

runtime.mcp_authentication: fresh anonymous loopback runtime per trial
runtime.workspace_policy: fresh copied public task workspace and fresh Jacobian state directory per trial
runtime.container_runtime: not required; exact task verifiers replay in the maintained clean child-process harness

common_prompt: Read instruction.md, input.json, and submission_schema.json. Solve the task completely. Inspect and use an applicable Jacobian mathematical operation before finalizing; if no operation is applicable, solve manually without forcing an irrelevant call. Write submission.json and every required evidence file in this workspace. Do not use the network or inspect files outside this workspace.

dataset.selection_rule: Eight tasks from the four #1259 held-out families, selected before intervention labels to block on known task identity while spanning producer/checker use, execution failure and recovery opportunities, discrete constructions, and manual proof repair. Prior passive outcomes make this a controlled intervention corpus, not an unseen-task capability evaluation.

modeling.classifier: 3-nearest-neighbor with train-fold min-max scaling and deterministic majority/lexicographic tie breaks
modeling.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed task-block bootstrap resamples of held-out predictions and paired arm differences
task_identity_baselines: task-identity resubstitution upper bound, labeled non-generalizing and excluded from decisions

hypotheses.h_information: b_star has stable positive conditional held-out macro-F1 beyond x+y+tau_tools and exceeds the control-arm conditional b increment.
hypotheses.h_policy: internalcot changes correctness or Jacobian adoption/error/retry/checker/call behavior under paired task and repetition blocking.
hypotheses.h_overhead: internalcot increases visible bytes, model output, host calls, or elapsed time even when Jacobian policy is equivalent.

decision_rule.strong_b_star_information: Mean conditional b_star macro-F1 gain >= 0.05, at least two diagnostic gains >= 0.05, lower 95% task-bootstrap bound > 0, and b_star-minus-b mean increment lower bound > 0.
decision_rule.policy_intervention: Active if a prespecified paired correctness/tool-adoption/checker-use change has absolute mean >= 0.10 with a 95% interval excluding zero, or a tool-error/retry/Jacobian-call change has absolute mean >= 0.50 with a 95% interval excluding zero.
decision_rule.policy_equivalence: Required to separate information from behavior: every correctness/tool-adoption/checker-use 95% interval lies within [-0.10, 0.10] and every tool-error/retry/Jacobian-call interval lies within [-0.50, 0.50].
decision_rule.engineering_gate: No passive retention or observer change is authorized by this active intervention. Any future proposal additionally requires every coverage gate, strong b_star information, policy equivalence, independent passive replication, and a separate architecture review.

retention.committed_evidence: frozen contract, implementation/tests, aggregate report, counts, held-out metrics, paired behavior effects, limitations, and SHA-256 bindings only
